chars.GIRL: a 21-year-old Moroccan young woman with long dark wavy hair, wearing a lilac oversized hoodie over a white top, light blue wide-leg jeans, white sneakers, small gold hoop earrings
chars.MOM: a Moroccan mother in her late 40s wearing a mustard-yellow house djellaba and a loose cream headscarf, reading glasses hanging on a cord
chars.FRIEND: a 21-year-old Moroccan young woman with a short black bob haircut, wearing a red tracksuit jacket
chars.MAN: a Moroccan man around 30 with a neat black beard and slicked-back hair, wearing a black leather jacket over a white t-shirt, a silver chain, black jeans

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Cozy Moroccan bedroom in the morning. GIRL stands at a mirror putting on lipstick, dressed up nicely. MOM stands in the doorway with crossed arms and raised eyebrows, suspicious, asking where she is going. GIRL glances back with a nervous innocent smile. Both faces visible, head-to-waist framing, subjects in the center.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night, split composition: on the left GIRL sits on her bed in pyjamas whispering into her phone with a conspiratorial grin; on the right FRIEND in her own room on the phone, giving a thumbs up and winking, promising to cover for her. Warm lamp light, playful mood.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: GIRL walks alone through a narrow old Moroccan alley with white and blue walls and closed wooden doors, holding her phone with a map, looking around lost and unsure. Daylight, subject in the center of the frame.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In front of a modern building entrance on a quiet Moroccan street, MAN waits by the door with a big charming smile and opens his arms to greet GIRL, who arrives with a polite but shy smile. Both faces visible, medium shot.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Inside a stylish content-creator studio with ring lights, cameras on tripods, a neon sign shape without letters and a grey sofa. MAN proudly gestures around showing off the studio; GIRL follows a step behind, looking around impressed but cautious.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of GIRL standing in the studio, clutching her bag strap with both hands, uneasy expression, glancing toward the door as if she wants to go home. Ring lights blurred in the background.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In the studio, MAN stands too close to GIRL, leaning in with a sly smile while pointing at a camera; GIRL leans slightly away with an awkward forced smile. Tension, both faces visible, medium shot, nothing explicit.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: GIRL in the dim corner of the studio, wide worried eyes, holding her phone tightly against her chest, thinking hard, shadows from the ring light on the wall behind her. Suspenseful mood, face clearly visible.
